author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks, ....
I would like to submit my newest map " Monsterbash" for consideration.
It is a walls map with a twist. This map uses villagers to conduct trades with players.........  ..............Pics:    New Pic Link :   http://imgur.com/a/X24cQ and
   Map :  ( updated to v 1.2 ) https://www.dropbox.com/s/gjy0h3lgj9eggek/monsterbash.zip?dl=0
.....1st- get an Iron pick from the tools Vendor - he accepts lots of things for trade, flowers, dirt, stone, coal, etc... everyone will get a pick with little effort.
 
2nd - Mine Emeralds to turn into trade vendors for Armor, Weapons, Supplies to do battle with.........
  
3rd- If you kill mobs in the middle or loot chests in the middle they will have special items that you can trade to vendors for Upgraded Armor and upgraded Weapons..........
  
4th- The last team alive wins.....
.... That's it -I hope you like. This map was tested and works on Bukkit 1.7.10 or higher. Will also work on 1.8.1 standard minecraft.I tested this map with several players from Avicus, and everyone that played it thought I should submit it here - So here ya go.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Folks -

This is just an update to Monsterbash. ( Dropbox link updates )

First I want to thank everyone for all of the nice things said in game about the map...

Here are a List of Fixes:
  1. Blue team replaced with "Orange"  - Blue team could not break blocks so I remade the YML and replaced the blue team with orange - I hope this fixes the problems.
  2. Re-balanced the mobs in the mid section
  3. Removed potions that were too powerful
  4. Redesigned the inside of the tower to allow better trading
  5. Added two of each vendor to stop team greifing
  6. Re-balanced Armor sets , tear costs ,and items to stream-line play
  7. Removed unnecessary items, to simplify game play
  8. Upgraded starting pick to make mining faster
  9. Added more emeralds to support larger team sizes
  10. Added food to almost every vendor
Thanks all for now - please let me know in-game if you find anymore bugs once this is updated.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Version Update 1.2

As we continue to see how new types of maps work, we will continue to update them to keep the game-play fair and fun.

  •  -Removed Over powered Healing potions that were leading to extended games
  •  +Updated  Bridge walls height - so player wont get knocked into the Void as easy
  • +Added Fire Protection to Mobs so that if Daylight Cycles the mobs wont burn to death
  • +Added Slowness / Hunger potions / Lava Buckets / TNT / Webs
  • +Added Wooden Fire Sword to help with those nasty webs
  • -Removed Tear Weapon / Armor  Shop
  • +Added Tear Misc Shop to replace Tear Armor/Weapon Shop.
  • -Removed potion shops from quads

That's about it until next time. Thanks for reading
